description: This file defines the ProductReviewDao interface, which extends SalesManagerEntityDao and provides method signatures for accessing product reviews based on various criteria such as customer, product, and language.

classes.name: ProductReviewDao
classes.description: Interface extending SalesManagerEntityDao to manage ProductReview entities with specific query methods.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductReview objects associated with a specific Customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductReview objects associated with a specific Product.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductReview objects for a specific Product in a specific Language.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductReview object for a specific Product and Customer identified by their IDs.
